projects.title: Nexus Voice
projects.description: Nexus Voice is a production-ready, real-time Voice AI Assistant built with a high-performance Cascaded Pipeline Architecture. It achieves sub-second (<1.2s) end-to-end response times. Built with a streaming cascaded pipeline (STT → LLM → TTS), the system features intelligent response modes, custom digital signal processing (DSP), and multi-user session management via PostgreSQL and Redis.
projects.languages: Python | React | FastAPI | Asyncio | Prisma ORM | WebSockets | Tailwind CSS | PostgreSQL | Redis

projects.title: NST Cluster
projects.description: Designed and deployed a 5-node Kubernetes cluster (1 control plane, 4 worker nodes) on Ubuntu Server using kubeadm. Implemented Calico CNI for pod networking, and validated cluster functionality by deploying and exposing containerized applications. Ensured node-level networking, kernel tuning, and production-ready configurations.
projects.languages: Kubernetes (kubeadm) | containerd (CRI) | Linux (Ubuntu Server) | Calico CNI | Networking (CNI, NodePort) | Systemd | cgroups
